paper_id: Enabling Unsupervised Neural Machine Translation with Word-level Visual Representations
title: Enabling Unsupervised Neural Machine Translation with Word-level Visual Representations
motivation: UNMT混淆相似词(如lion译成rabbit), 高质量双语词典成本高, 需低成本替代方案
problem_framing: 纯单语语料无法提供词级翻译监督, 导致分布相似的词混淆
key_insight: 图像跨语言一致性使word-level图片成为比bilingual dictionary更廉价的lexical mapping信号
method_signature: 修改embedding层+mask transformer注入图片, 用visible matrix隔离图像对无关词的影响
evaluation_criteria: Multi30k数据集BLEU分数, 1-gram precision, 与XLM/UNMT-CS对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 未能有效处理一词多义问题, 图片通过网页爬取, 可能不完全对应同一语义
evidence_for_taste: high-quality bilingual dictionaries can be costly
the physical visual perception is congruent among speakers
we have not been able to effectively handle the issue of polysemy
adding three images may introduce more noise
thinking_moves: 用perception的跨语言一致性绕过lexical supervision缺失的工程难题
从sentence-level改为word-level粒度, 降低图片收集难度的工程tradeoff
通过mask transformer强制图像只与对应词交互, 避免破坏句子结构
固定选图效果不如随机选图, 说明数据多样性比精确匹配更重要
